+def _sse_payload(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    raw_len = len(raw)
+    data_at = raw.find("data:")
+    while data_at != -1 and data_at != 0 and raw[data_at - 1] not in "\r\n":
+        data_at = raw.find("data:", data_at + 5)
+    if data_at == -1:
+        return None
+
+    value_start = data_at + 5
+    next_lf = raw.find("\n", value_start)
+    next_cr = raw.find("\r", value_start)
+    if next_lf == -1:
+        end = next_cr
+    elif next_cr == -1:
+        end = next_lf
+    else:
+        end = next_cr if next_cr < next_lf else next_lf
+    if end == -1:
+        end = raw_len
+        scan_at = raw_len
+    else:
+        scan_at = end + 1
+        if raw[end] == "\r" and scan_at < raw_len and raw[scan_at] == "\n":
+            scan_at += 1
+
+    next_data = raw.find("data:", scan_at)
+    while next_data != -1:
+        if next_data == 0 or raw[next_data - 1] in "\r\n":
+            return _sse_payload_lines(raw)
+        next_data = raw.find("data:", next_data + 5)
+
+    data_text = raw[value_start:end].strip()
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(data_text) if data_text else {}
+        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"raw": data_text}
+

+def _sse_payload_lines(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    data_parts: list[str] = []
+    start = 0
+    raw_len = len(raw)
+    while start < raw_len:
+        next_lf = raw.find("\n", start)
+        next_cr = raw.find("\r", start)
+        if next_lf == -1:
+            end = next_cr
+        elif next_cr == -1:
+            end = next_lf
+        else:
+            end = next_cr if next_cr < next_lf else next_lf
+        if end == -1:
+            line = raw[start:]
+            start = raw_len
+        else:
+            line = raw[start:end]
+            start = end + 1
+            if raw[end] == "\r" and start < raw_len and raw[start] == "\n":
+                start += 1
+        if line.startswith("data:"):
+            data_parts.append(line[5:].strip())
+    if not data_parts:
+        return None
+    data_text = "\n".join(data_parts)
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(data_text) if data_text else {}
+        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"raw": data_text}
